scope: Bounded audit of three named sources, not exhaustive; no third-party full text archived.

sources.title: On the Existence of Semi-regular Sequences
sources.role: Square-zero definition, conditional Hilbert series, fixed-type nonexistence; not the relative product-clause model.

sources.title: On the Complexity of Solving Quadratic Boolean Systems
sources.role: Conditional algorithmic analysis and conjecture for random quadratic systems; no matching-relative theorem.

sources.authors: Bigdeli, De Negri, Dizdarevic, Gorla, Minko, Tsakou
sources.title: Semi-regular sequences and other random systems of equations
sources.role: Ordinary polynomial-ring notion; finite-field theorem assumes cryptographic semi-regularity.
